name: zera-solutions-desktop

scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prepare:app && electron .
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/check-platform.mjs darwin && npm run build:frontend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config .desktop-build/electron-builder.generated.json --mac dmg
scripts.build:win: node scripts/check-platform.mjs win32 && npm run build:frontend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config .desktop-build/electron-builder.generated.json --win nsis
scripts.build:customer:mac: node scripts/check-platform.mjs darwin && npm run build:frontend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config .desktop-build/electron-builder.generated.json --mac dmg
scripts.build:customer:win: node scripts/check-platform.mjs win32 && npm run build:frontend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config .desktop-build/electron-builder.generated.json --win nsis

description: Zera shop management with a private local database
